description: Hello #TeamCastro! We are T-34 days until Election Day! That means Get Out The Vote is about to start! We are excited and ready for the next month of voter contact and engagement. Be on the lookout for many exciting things from #TeamCastro as we spread the word about this campaign and what we can accomplish when leadership puts people first! Relational organizing will be more important than ever during this final countdown. This week I challenge you to share these important reminders with your friends, families and networks: 1. The deadline to register to vote is October 5th and fast approaching! You can check your status at: mvp.sos.ga.gov 2. Early voting starts on October 13th. Make your plan to vote today! Darcy Castro Candidate for Georgia Senate District 37
title: News from Darcy Castro
